purpose: Run bounded deep research questions that improve market/cycle understanding across 1-3 day, 5-7 day and 2-3 week horizons using only provider connections that have survived the MCP connection evaluation program.

1_3D.purpose: tactical direction, stress, continuation, squeeze/flush and transition context

5_7D.purpose: rotation persistence, breadth/liquidity continuation and near-term cycle transition

2_3W.purpose: cycle direction, capital rotation, participation and distribution context

CROSS_HORIZON.purpose: explicitly preserve agreement and conflict between horizons

items.title: Cross-Horizon Directional Market Map - Baseline
items.primary_goal: Build a provider-grounded evidence map for short and intermediate market direction without replacing framework state.
items.question: Which source-backed signals currently support risk-on, risk-off, range/chop or transition at 1-3 days, 5-7 days and 2-3 weeks, and where do the horizons disagree?
items.hypothesis: Separating evidence by horizon and preserving disagreement improves directional understanding versus one blended market narrative.
items.baseline: Existing canonical framework state and current deterministic owner outputs, with CoinGecko as research-only context.
items.decision_divergence: Research is useful only if it exposes horizon-specific evidence or conflict not already visible in the canonical owner outputs.
items.falsifier: The research adds no horizon-specific information, merely restates price direction, or cannot preserve provenance.
items.kill_condition: Kill or demote if repeated runs remain explanatory-only or materially duplicate canonical context.

items.title: Altseason Pre-Trigger Buy-Window Anatomy
items.primary_goal: Improve understanding of the sequence that can precede broad alt participation and the best risk/reward accumulation window.
items.question: What sequence of breadth expansion, BTC-to-ETH-to-alt rotation, stablecoin/liquidity deployment, onchain/DEX activity and narrative acceleration tends to appear before broad alt participation, and which components lead versus merely confirm?
items.hypothesis: A multi-domain sequence can improve timing context around early rotation without inventing a new threshold or rule.
items.baseline: FIRST_ETHBTC_CROSS and existing rotation evidence owners.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if the research identifies incremental pre-trigger information, delay costs or false-rotation filters beyond existing rotation context.
items.falsifier: Signals are redundant, late, non-reproducible, or only become visible after the alt move is already mature.
items.kill_condition: Do not retain any component that fails incremental-value review or increases delay without reducing false rotations.

items.title: Distribution Precursor and Exit-Window Anatomy
items.primary_goal: Improve early understanding of distribution risk before broad post-altseason deterioration.
items.question: Which combinations of narrowing leadership, social euphoria, exchange/onchain flow asymmetry, weakening participation, DEX/protocol deceleration and price-volume divergence appear before distribution rather than after it?
items.hypothesis: Distribution risk is better understood through divergence between attention/price and participation/capital/usage than through price weakness alone.
items.baseline: Current framework exit/distribution interpretation and deterministic market owners.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if evidence becomes visible before canonical deterioration or explains false-positive exit warnings.
items.falsifier: Evidence appears only after price breaks down, is dominated by one provider, or cannot distinguish healthy consolidation from distribution.
items.kill_condition: Kill components that are late, unstable, or repeatedly trigger during healthy continuation.

items.title: Provider Incremental Value by Horizon
items.primary_goal: Determine which retained connections actually improve horizon-specific understanding and which are redundant.
items.question: For each horizon, what unique evidence does each retained provider contribute beyond CoinGecko and existing deterministic owners, and what is merely duplicated context?
items.hypothesis: A small provider set with measured incremental value will outperform a larger overlapping research stack in clarity, reliability and cost.
items.baseline: CoinGecko baseline plus canonical deterministic sources.
items.decision_divergence: Provider earns retention only by changing evidence coverage, conflict resolution or recovery capability in a reproducible way.
items.falsifier: Provider output is mostly overlapping, unstable, costly or source-recovery-only without material research value.
items.kill_condition: Demote or kill provider research role when unique information remains negligible after bounded repeated challenges.

items.title: Spot-Futures-Onchain Divergence - 1 to 3 Days
items.primary_goal: Improve short-horizon transition awareness by studying disagreement between spot price/volume, derivatives diagnostics and onchain flow.
items.question: When spot, derivatives diagnostics and onchain flow disagree, which divergence patterns precede continuation, squeeze, flush or range over the next 1-3 days?
items.hypothesis: Cross-domain disagreement contains more short-horizon information than same-direction confirmation.
items.baseline: Latest canonical short-horizon market context without MCP-derived evidence.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if divergence classification adds information not captured by price and canonical derivatives fields.
items.falsifier: Patterns are unstable, derivative access is unavailable, or apparent edge disappears when timestamp/provenance is enforced.
items.kill_condition: Kill if no repeated source-backed divergence value emerges.

items.title: Breadth and Alt Participation Pulse
items.primary_goal: Clarify whether broad participation is expanding, narrowing or rotating across horizons.
items.question: Does category and asset breadth lead, confirm or fail subsequent continuation, and how does leadership concentration change across 1-3d, 5-7d and 2-3w?
items.hypothesis: Breadth quality and leadership concentration provide cycle context beyond headline total-market direction.
items.baseline: Existing breadth and dominance owners.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if it surfaces participation structure not already represented by canonical breadth inputs.
items.falsifier: CoinGecko/CMC/altFINS breadth views are redundant with existing owners or too unstable for horizon comparison.
items.kill_condition: Keep only as recovery/context if incremental information is not demonstrated.

items.title: Social Acceleration Lead-Lag
items.primary_goal: Determine whether social acceleration is early information, confirmation or late-cycle echo.
items.question: Across assets/categories, does social attention acceleration lead price/volume/breadth, move concurrently, or lag, and does the relationship change near early rotation versus euphoria?
items.hypothesis: The value of social data is regime-dependent and may be useful primarily as acceleration/divergence context rather than directional confirmation.
items.baseline: Price, volume and breadth without social intelligence.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if social data changes timing/context before price-volume confirmation or flags euphoria divergence.
items.falsifier: Social metrics consistently lag price or add no incremental information after volume/breadth controls.
items.kill_condition: Remain shadow-only or kill if repeated lead-lag studies show no unique value.

items.title: Stablecoin and Liquidity Impulse
items.primary_goal: Improve medium-horizon risk-appetite context from deployable crypto liquidity.
items.question: Do changes in stablecoin supply, venue deployment and onchain liquidity precede changes in broad crypto participation over 5-7 days and 2-3 weeks?
items.hypothesis: Liquidity deployment may lead broad risk participation even when headline price remains range-bound.
items.baseline: Existing stablecoin/liquidity owners and market-cap context.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if the research distinguishes idle supply from deployed liquidity and adds timing context.
items.falsifier: Stablecoin changes are too slow, dominated by issuance mechanics, or add no incremental timing information.
items.kill_condition: Kill predictive interpretation if only contemporaneous or structural context survives.

items.title: Exchange Flow Asymmetry
items.primary_goal: Study whether exchange-directed versus off-exchange/onchain flow asymmetry improves accumulation/distribution context.
items.question: Which source-backed exchange-flow asymmetries are associated with short-horizon accumulation, distribution, squeeze risk or false alarms?
items.hypothesis: Flow direction is useful mainly when interpreted with price response and participation rather than as a standalone bullish/bearish signal.
items.baseline: Price/volume context without MCP-derived flow detail.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if flow asymmetry explains or anticipates price-volume behavior.
items.falsifier: Entity attribution is unreliable, flows are dominated by internal transfers, or no reproducible divergence exists.
items.kill_condition: Kill directional use if attribution uncertainty or false positives dominate.

items.title: DEX and Protocol Activity Regime Change
items.primary_goal: Test whether broadening or decelerating real usage adds cycle-transition context.
items.question: Do changes in DEX volume breadth, active protocols/users and transaction activity precede or confirm sector/cycle transitions?
items.hypothesis: Broadening usage can distinguish durable capital rotation from price-only narrative bursts.
items.baseline: Price/category performance without protocol activity.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if activity breadth changes interpretation beyond price and volume.
items.falsifier: Activity follows price, is incentive-driven noise, or is too fragmented to reproduce.
items.kill_condition: Demote to explanatory context if no leading or crosscheck value survives.

items.title: BTC-ETH-Alt Rotation Sequence
items.primary_goal: Improve cycle sequencing around BTC leadership, ETH handoff and broad alt participation.
items.question: What ordering and survival patterns across BTC, ETH, ETH/BTC, breadth, category leadership, liquidity and usage distinguish real rotation from temporary beta bursts?
items.hypothesis: Sequence and survival matter more than a single cross or dominance print.
items.baseline: FIRST_ETHBTC_CROSS and existing T6 rotation-survival baseline.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if added domains reduce fake rotations without unacceptable delay.
items.falsifier: Additional domains are redundant, late or worsen delay cost.
items.kill_condition: Collapse redundant domains and keep the simplest surviving sequence.

items.title: Narrative Durability versus Pump Decay
items.primary_goal: Distinguish narrative attention supported by capital/usage from transient hype.
items.question: Which combinations of attention persistence, volume, category breadth and onchain/protocol activity distinguish durable narratives from fast-decaying pumps?
items.hypothesis: Narrative durability requires confirmation in capital participation or usage, while attention-only spikes decay faster.
items.baseline: Price/volume and category trend without social data.
items.decision_divergence: Useful if it changes research prioritization or identifies late-cycle attention-capital divergence.
items.falsifier: Narrative labels are unstable or social metrics add no value after price/volume controls.
items.kill_condition: Keep only candidate-discovery context if durability classification is not reproducible.

items.title: Capital Rotation by Category
items.primary_goal: Map where capital participation is broadening or concentrating across crypto sectors.
items.question: Which categories show simultaneous price, volume, liquidity and usage broadening, and does this sequence precede broader market rotation?
items.hypothesis: Category rotation backed by liquidity/usage is more durable than price-only leadership.
items.baseline: CoinGecko category performance alone.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if additional domains materially reorder category conviction or cycle interpretation.
items.falsifier: Onchain/category mapping is too noisy or additional providers merely mirror price.
items.kill_condition: Demote to category context if no durable incremental signal exists.

items.title: Narrative-Capital Decoupling
items.primary_goal: Identify attention/price euphoria that is not confirmed by fresh capital or participation.
items.question: When social attention accelerates while breadth, liquidity or usage fails to confirm, does the divergence more often precede exhaustion, rotation or harmless consolidation?
items.hypothesis: Narrative-capital decoupling is more useful as late-cycle/distribution context than as a standalone short signal.
items.baseline: Social attention or price direction considered independently.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if divergence is visible before deterioration and separates euphoria from healthy continuation.
items.falsifier: Divergence is common during healthy trends and has poor timing.
items.kill_condition: Keep shadow-only or kill if false-positive cost is high.

items.title: Evidence Latency Map
items.primary_goal: Measure which evidence families tend to change first, second and last around transitions.
items.question: Across retained providers and canonical owners, which evidence families move first around rotation, flush, recovery and distribution, and how stable is the ordering?
items.hypothesis: Latency ordering can improve interpretation without assigning new market weights.
items.baseline: Same-time snapshot interpretation.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if temporal ordering is stable enough to distinguish leading from confirming context.
items.falsifier: Ordering is regime-unstable or driven by source update cadence rather than market behavior.
items.kill_condition: Kill any lead/lag claim that cannot separate data latency from economic latency.

items.title: Horizon Conflict Anatomy
items.primary_goal: Improve interpretation when short-term and medium-term evidence point in different directions.
items.question: What recurring structures occur when 1-3d evidence is risk-on but 2-3w context is weak, or vice versa, and which evidence resolves versus merely postpones the conflict?
items.hypothesis: Explicit horizon conflict classification is more accurate than forcing one blended directional call.
items.baseline: Single blended narrative across horizons.
items.decision_divergence: Useful if it prevents short-term noise from being mistaken for cycle change or medium-term bias from obscuring tactical transitions.
items.falsifier: Conflicts cannot be classified reproducibly or add no decision-relevant context.
items.kill_condition: Keep as descriptive only if no stable resolution pattern emerges.

items.title: Regime Transition Anatomy
items.primary_goal: Deepen understanding of transitions from accumulation/range to rotation, broad participation, euphoria and distribution.
items.question: Which source-backed state changes and divergences consistently distinguish transition phases without relying on hindsight labels?
items.hypothesis: Transition anatomy can improve cycle understanding when built from timestamped source changes rather than retrospective narratives.
items.baseline: Current canonical cycle interpretation.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if phase-transition evidence is observable prospectively and adds context beyond existing labels.
items.falsifier: Phase distinctions require hindsight, source timestamps are insufficient, or evidence is mostly semantic relabeling.
items.kill_condition: Reject any phase model that cannot be reconstructed from contemporaneous evidence.

items.title: False-Positive and False-Negative Library
items.primary_goal: Improve understanding of missed opportunity versus protective restraint around entry, rotation and exit context.
items.question: Which research-context patterns most often look persuasive but fail, and which protective interpretations repeatedly miss genuine continuation or rotation?
items.hypothesis: A structured error library improves calibration by making both defensive success and opportunity cost visible.
items.baseline: Existing FNP cumulative framework and current research narratives.
items.decision_divergence: Useful if it produces source-backed error categories that can support existing FNP work without retroactive rescoring.
items.falsifier: Cases depend on hindsight reconstruction or cannot be linked to frozen contemporaneous evidence.
items.kill_condition: No retrospective pseudo-rows; route only prospective/verified cases to existing governance.

items.title: Independent Market Crosscheck and Recovery Value
items.primary_goal: Measure whether a second market-data provider improves source recovery and detects meaningful discrepancies.
items.question: When CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap disagree on market cap, volume, category or ranking context, are discrepancies actionable research context, source-timing artifacts or harmless methodology differences?
items.hypothesis: Independent crosscheck value is highest for anomaly detection and recovery, not as a second vote on market direction.
items.baseline: CoinGecko baseline alone.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if CMC catches source problems or materially changes research context.
items.falsifier: Discrepancies are mostly methodology noise and recovery benefit is negligible.
items.kill_condition: Demote CMC to exception-only recovery if routine crosscheck value is low.

items.title: Leader-Laggard Transition
items.primary_goal: Understand leadership handoffs and whether laggards are catching up or leaders are exhausting.
items.question: How do leadership concentration, relative momentum, breadth catch-up and capital participation behave before healthy broadening versus terminal laggard rotation?
items.hypothesis: The quality of leader-to-laggard handoff can distinguish early broadening from late-cycle indiscriminate chasing.
items.baseline: Headline market direction and category returns.
items.decision_divergence: Useful only if leadership structure adds cycle context beyond absolute returns.
items.falsifier: Leader/laggard labels are unstable or merely re-express recent performance.
items.kill_condition: Keep as descriptive breadth context if no reproducible transition value emerges.
